Senior government affairs and public policy leader with 10 years of experience shaping pharmaceutical, biotech and health policy across Europe and globally. My work spans EU, national and international levels — connecting Ipsen’s corporate strategy with evolving policy environments to drive access, innovation and competitiveness.

At Ipsen, I lead the Government Affairs & Policy function, coordinating engagement with policymakers, industry associations (EFPIA, BIO, national trade bodies) and internal experts across R&D, Market Access, and Corporate Affairs. I steer Ipsen’s advocacy on competitiveness, regulatory frameworks, and access to innovation, aligning country-level strategies with global priorities.

Key areas of expertise:
• Global and EU health & pharmaceutical policy
• Coordination of country and cross-functional policy engagement
• Stakeholder & thought leadership strategy
• Market access and rare diseases policy
• Executive communications and strategic positioning

Recognised for fostering trusted dialogue between industry and public decision-makers, and for shaping policy narratives that advance both patient access and sustainable healthcare innovation.
